names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 22 iunie, «Sfântul Ierarh Grigorie Dascălul, Mitropolitul Țării Românești»; the form is the name and the byname the line gives, the rest being rank and see.

death.note: doxologia.ro's page for the synaxis of the Athonite saints prints him as «Sfântul Ierarh Grigorie Dascălul, Mitropolitul Țării Românești (1765-1834)»; his own life gives 1823–1834 as his years in the see and no year of death.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
